services.desc: Experience the Real Monterey: Walk Through History on Cannery Row! 🌊 Join us for Monterey's most beloved walking tour, where local stories come alive with every step! Our expert guides will take you on an unforgettable journey along the historic waterfront and through the heart of Cannery Row. What Makes Our Tours Special? blurb: Explore historic adobes and Steinbeck’s famous Cannery Row, experiencing Old Monterey’s colonial treasures and sardine-era waterfront. Learn the history of the Monterey Bay Aquarium and see birds and sea mammals on Cannery Row. Hear tales of Spanish explorers and visit must-see historic adobe landmarks including California Historic Landmark #1.

faq.a: Tours of historic Monterey are scheduled at 10:00 AM every Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Cannery Row walking tours are scheduled at 2:00 PM every Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Historic Monterey walking tours, Monterey waterfront tours and Cannery Row walking tours can also be arranged by request.
